description: This is a Java class defining the 'Note' entity for the notes backend application, including JPA annotations for ORM mapping, fields for note properties, and lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note, with properties for ID, title, content, creation and update timestamps, including lifecycle callbacks for managing timestamps.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Default constructor for the Note class.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for creating a Note with a title and content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Callback method invoked before persisting a new Note; sets createdAt and updatedAt to current timestamp.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Callback method invoked before updating an existing Note; updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the note.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the note.
